source: SPEC-v9-clearing.md §9 (Scribe): v9 UI/copy pack — missed-station report lines, walk-away row, dimmed-reason templates, almanac labels, render-fault copy, station chrome hints. Voice per src/data/v3-copy.json: terse, ledger-brained. Naming per SPEC §8: originals only.

missed_stations.note: Era report card (SPEC v9 §1.2): one line per station the route skipped. Variants rotate at runtime; each cites a stake, not a specific title, so it reads true for any missed station in the era.
era_1: A fire-offer went out from that clearing. No answer was logged.
Someone carried a question to that ridge. The ridge kept it.
One camp on this route stayed a maybe. The cold filed it anyway.
era_2: A field on this route stands unsurveyed. Rent accrues regardless.
The seed offer aged in the ground. Nobody signed against it.
One furrow-line was never cut. The valley tallies it as lost.
era_3: A tablet went uncut on this march. The debt rides unsigned.
Someone waited at the ford with terms. The crossing moved on.
One claim stayed oral. Stone remembers nothing you didn't write.
era_4: A road offered its problem here. It remains unsolved, on schedule.
One copy was never made. Whatever it held is officially lost.
A courier waited at a bridge nobody crossed. Standing time: one era.
era_5: A printed question stayed unanswered. The press has moved on.
One shop kept its shutter down. The argument ripened without you.
A guild roll went unwritten here. Apprenticeships accrued elsewhere.
era_6: A berth left without you. The manifest lists it as cargo.
One ledger entry sailed empty. Interest compounded on schedule.
An offer rode at anchor past this headland. It made port elsewhere.
era_7: A clause stayed unwritten on this road. Somebody still pays for it.
One pamphlet went unread. The grievance found another reader.
A committee sat and waited. Quorum: none. History: still itemized.
era_8: A seam stays uncut here. The smoke bill keeps its own hours.
One engine sat cold at the pit-head. Coal prices noted the gap.
A shift went unwalked. The wage book has no column for maybe.
era_9: A valve stayed shut on this stretch. Pressure billed someone else.
One pump-house closed before you reached it. The queue dispersed.
A lease lay unsigned in a company town. Ambition filed elsewhere.
era_10: A form stayed unstamped here. The queue forgave no one else.
One checkpoint found nothing to approve. The year was audited anyway.
A ration went uncounted on this route. The shortfall was spread evenly.
era_11: A dial stayed unset here. Midnight declined to wait for anyone.
One bunker took no inventory. The countdown ran regardless.
A signal passed this station unread. The clock holds the message.
era_12: A lane went unsprinted here. The scoreboard credits other names.
One exchange floor rang for no one. The quote stands corrected.
A test bench stayed cold. The beeping continued without comment.
era_13: A cabinet hummed at this stop and got no order. Cycles were wasted.
One forecast shipped unreviewed. Interest compounds on omissions.
A patch went undeployed here. The system assumed the worst, correctly.
era_14: A meter was never read here. The invoice arrived anyway, totalled.
One panel stayed bare of wiring. The grid priced the absence.
A hearing opened and adjourned without testimony. The climate logged it.
era_15: A feed scrolled past this moment unwatched. The metric missed nothing.
One notification expired unread. Attention was spent downstream.
A trend crested and died unheard here. The dashboard records both.
era_16: A message waited nine years at this relay. It was answered by other hands.
One sleep-shift went undreamed here. The roster marked it nominal.
A course correction went unsent. The drift filed it under weather.
era_17: A fork stayed unuploaded. The estate settled without its opinion.
One deposition was never taken. The heirs proceed by assumption.
A claim went unfiled in the final court. Docketed: lost, with interest.

walk_away: Walk away. The ledger accepts your absence.
Refuse the whole board. Entropy takes the fee.
Turn around. Unanswered questions still accrue.
Leave it standing. The world charges silence.
Decline all. Something always pays the difference.

dim_reasons.note: Templates for dimmed choices (SPEC v9 §2). <thing>/<pool> substituted at runtime. ≤48 chars each.
dim_reasons.pool_too_low_knowledge: You don't know enough to sign
dim_reasons.pool_too_low_legitimacy: No one would honor your word
dim_reasons.entropy_tier_1: The low zones won't hear it
dim_reasons.entropy_tier_4: Only the deep zones would take it

render_fault.stripe: RENDER FAULT — the world holds its last good frame. Press R.
render_fault.toast: Three faults running. Paused on the last good frame. Press R to repaint.

station_ui.leave_hint: Esc leaves it open. Nothing is owed yet.
